title: Game Server Instances Configuration
description: Define which server instances to launch during local development. Each server is its own executable project.

solution.description: Path to the solution to build once before launching

servers.description: List of server instances to launch

name.description: Display name for the server window

project.description: Path to the server csproj (relative to repo root)

dll.description: Output dll file name produced by the project

healthPort.description: HTTP health check / admin / routing port

default.description: Informational marker for the directory/default server
